issues.explanation: The same new entry is added under the historic [0.0.0] release as well as [Unreleased]; released history should stay immutable.

Entity/member writes (addMember, assignRole, removeMember, save, delete, transfer) live directly in Livewire components with no app/Actions/* class, contrary to the domain-writes-through-Actions rule.
Settings validates name/slug through a rules() method instead of the project's #[Validate] attribute pattern used in Members.

conventions.evidence: Follows most conventions: #[Locked] entity (Dashboard.php:75, Members.php:117, Settings.php:251), #[Validate] email (Members.php:119), policies for auth, x-form-field/x-button Blade components, docs + CHANGELOG updated; deviations: no app/Actions/* for writes, Settings uses rules() not #[Validate], CHANGELOG historic edit

readability.evidence: Clear names (membership(), transfer(), manageable()), small focused methods, consistent Layout/Locked style, PHPDoc on pick/addMember/transfer; no dead code

requirements.evidence: Migrations entities_slug_unique (2026_10_29_033007:775) + owner_seq/one-owner index (2026_10_29_033008:813-818); Entity.php:370 owner()/slug, UserRole.php:543 manageable, policies view/update/manageSettings, EntityController.php:44 pick with audit, Dashboard/Members/Settings mount auth, routes web.php:1163-1168, lang nav_members/nav_settings/owner_notice/transfer_ownership

scope.evidence: All models, policies, controller, Livewire pages, routes, lang, docs, tests serve the entity task; only unrelated edit is the duplicated CHANGELOG entry under [0.0.0]

security.evidence: Gate::authorize view in pick (EntityController.php:44) before session write; mount() authorize in all pages; Locked entity; membership() scoped to entity + authorize (Members.php:217); transfer scoped admin lookup + owner check in transaction (Settings.php:320); {{ }} escaping; mass-assignment via Fillable

simplicity.evidence: Lean Eloquent + policies, no service layers, reuses Route::livewire/auth middleware/Blade components; rate-limit and lockForUpdate are minimal justified additions

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/EntityDataModelTest, EntityPoliciesTest, EntityPickTest, EntityDashboardTest, EntityMembersTest, EntitySettingsTest cover happy path, validation errors, unauthorized calls, foreign-id and locked-property tamper

review.summary: Adds entities/memberships schema with DB-level one-owner rule, policies, entity-pick endpoint and Livewire dashboard/members/settings pages with strong auth and tests. Minor deductions only for the duplicated historic CHANGELOG entry and small convention deviations (no Actions, rules() vs #[Validate]); otherwise ready to merge with nits.
